name: Search and Client Workspace
livePromotion: Promoted to live code on 2026-10-09 at the user's explicit request; live app-specific configuration and role-loading differences preserved. Not published to Power Platform.
features: My Work: assigned-client/item quick search, advanced field filters and synchronized 50-record paging in Case Load, All Work and Pending Items
Client and program searches: typed field filters combined with normal text search, existing program/role/archive boundaries and server paging

Advanced Search limited to Client Profile (Record ID, Name, Date of Birth, Race, Gender), Program Enrollment (Service Start Date, Service End Date, Program), Services (Date of Service, Service Category, Service) and Bed Enrollment (Check In Date). Other forms retain normal search without Advanced Search. Existing text/date operators remain unchanged; My Work uses only the requested client/enrollment fields and hydrated Race/End Date values.
Client-linked form headers: client name and app Record ID, validated against the launch snapshot and current parent links
Opened client profile tables: accessible clickable text/date/number sorting headers with direction arrows
Helpline: Time of Contact and Call Length (minutes) required for new and edited records in every program
Services: selected REACH Center Program Enrollment requires Minutes and Meeting Mode for new and edited records; other program requirements are preserved
Client Profile: Name Data Quality required for new and edited records
Services client/enrollment quick views: Funder, Minutes and Service Time columns
Helpline client quick view: wrapped Call Notes column
Services: Program Information Only (125570071) first in Resource Navigation; existing service mappings preserved

Services Additional Service Detail: CARE (125570010) immediately above selectable Other (125570009); Somatic Series replaces Restorative Yoga at unchanged value 125570005, including stale configured labels

Home: What's New? and On The Horizon messages from cmps_messageses, scheduled by start/end times, with automatic refresh and timezone-aware boundaries; metadata reads omit unsupported top/paging parameters and failures identify the query stage

IT Admin Home Messages: Add/Edit form, generated MSG app IDs, schedule validation, optional archive/audit support and restore through Archived Records; management unavailable in View as User and program searches

All business form create/update saves: shared modal confirmation with form name and Record ID; Back to search, Remain on current record and Open Client Profile choices replace forced navigation. Remain retains saved row IDs, client navigation uses actual direct/enrollment links and View permission, and failed/partial/unconfirmed saves retain drafts with navigation disabled. Includes IT Admin Funder/Contract/Transaction and Home Message editors, safe household-history retries and Release of Information updates.
